note: Track dim-aug (theory-building-chords), step 3: major, minor, diminished and augmented triads on one root, built on D on the staff, heard as four chords on D, then named with eyes closed on A and on E. exercise.title: Major, minor, diminished or augmented
exercise.why: The 3rd makes a triad major or minor, and the 5th stays, drops a half step or rises a half step, so two notes over one root name the four triads.

cells.text:
Tap {{1}} {{3}} {{5}} on the staff below, then {{1}} {{b3}} {{5}}: D major and D minor, and only the 3rd moved.
Now tap {{1}}, {{b3}} and the ringed {{b5}} for D diminished, then {{1}}, {{3}} and the ringed {{#5}} for D augmented: the minor triad with its 5th lowered, and the major triad with its 5th raised.

Press a chord box below to hear the chord. Go from D to Daug and from Dm to Ddim, then press the four in any order.
Practice until you can hear which way the 5th moved.

Press a chord box below to hear the chord: the four triads on A, in a new order. Then look away, press a box without choosing, and name the triad before you look.
Listen to the 3rd first, then to the 5th.

Then do the same with the four triads on E here.
When you change the root, the notes are new but the 3rd and the 5th still name the triad.
